canon_ref.note: Dragon POV. He then spends two days re-warding the new lair.

b1.dragon_abandons_lair.summary: Sure that a stranger in his lair means assassins, the Dragon teleports away with his hoard to a backup lair he dislikes. He finds no pursuit and starts to think it was an accident.

canon_ref.note: What the arrangement is, and with which city, is not said. Timing is vague (day 3 to 'two weeks later').

b1.dragon_old_obligation.summary: Awake anyway, the Dragon checks his notes, sees a duty that falls every two hundred years, and contacts the nearest city to make arrangements. Then he goes back to sleep.

b1.erin_finds_amentus_orchard.summary: In daylight Erin sees two moons' sky, giant clouds and a far stone wall. She uses a band of coloured grass as a trail, finds a valley of blue-fruit trees to the east, and kicks a tree until fruit drops.

b1.rock_crab_ambush.summary: On the way to the trees, a boulder turns out to be the shell of a bus-sized crab. It snaps at Erin with two huge pincers and chases her downhill, then gives up and goes back.
